response.sql: SELECT bp.player_id, SUM(bp.triple) AS total_triples FROM batting_postseason AS bp WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM batting_postseason AS qualifying WHERE qualifying.player_id = bp.player_id AND qualifying.league_id = 'NL' AND qualifying.round = 'WS') GROUP BY bp.player_id ORDER BY total_triples IS NULL, total_triples DESC, bp.player_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A player qualifies if at least one postseason batting record is for an NL team in the World Series.

alternatives.interpretation: A player qualifies if they have an NL postseason batting record and a World Series batting record, even if those are different records.
